subject: Injury report – rear-end collision on I-95
body: I was stopped at a red light when another vehicle rear-ended my car at moderate speed. My airbag did not deploy. Since the accident I have had neck stiffness and shoulder soreness. I went to urgent care the same day and was told it was likely whiplash. I have been taking over-the-counter pain medication and the pain is a 5 out of 10. I am able to work but it is uncomfortable.

subject: Side-impact collision – follow-up on treatment
body: My vehicle was struck on the driver's side in a T-bone collision at an intersection. The airbag deployed. I had lower back pain and a mild headache after the accident. I have been to a chiropractor twice. Pain level is about 4 out of 10 and gradually improving. No loss of consciousness was reported at the scene.

subject: Whiplash claim – appointment request
body: I was involved in a car accident where another vehicle sideswiped mine on the highway. I have mild soreness in my upper back and some stiffness in my neck. I would like to schedule a follow-up appointment with my doctor. Symptoms are mild and I have not missed any work.
